result.title: FiVOS: A Fish Segmentation Algorithm Based on Interactive Video Object Segmentation and Filter Enhancement
result.summary: With the continuous expansion of aquaculture, precise and efficient monitoring of fish behavior has become increasingly critical for improving farming efficiency and reducing economic losses. In particular, with the ongoing enhancement of computational capabilities in deep learning models, vision-based fish segmentation methods are garnering growing attention. By analyzing video segmentation results, fish behavior can be effectively tracked, thereby providing reliable data support for the precise regulation of aquaculture environments. However, existing deep learning-based video segmentation methods for aquaculture scenarios often overlook the dynamic correlations between video frames. In contrast, Interactive Video Object Segmentation (IVOS) employs an interaction-propagation scheme to achieve high-precision segmentation while minimizing user effort, thereby enhancing monitoring efficiency. Yet, IVOS applications in aquaculture remain limited due to data scarcity, and are susceptible to error accumulation and mask loss over long sequence propagation due to high intra-class similarity. In response, this paper proposes an improved interactive video object segmentation method (FiVOS) and constructs two fish-specific datasets. FiVOS utilizes a mask block filter to enable early detection and correction of erroneous propagated mask blocks, enhancing filtering accuracy through a rule-based thresholding approach. Additionally, it serializes noise filters to further eliminate erroneous mask noise, thereby improving model robustness. Experimental results demonstrate that FiVOS achieves state-of-the-art (SOTA) performance in fish video segmentation tasks, providing robust technical support for fish behavior research.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 FiVOS，一种面向养殖场景的交互式视频目标分割方法，用 mask block 过滤器和规则阈值及早检测并修正传播错误的掩码，并构建了两个鱼类数据集，报告在该任务上达到 SOTA。
AI.relevance_reason: 其长序列传播中的误差累积与掩码丢失问题，与 LVR 中多步推理轨迹的状态污染、证据筛选和停止/纠错决策可能存在概念联系，可供核查；但方法本身是纯视觉分割，未涉及多模态推理或 latent 状态生成，故仅作远领域启发。
